[{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Hey, I really need to talk."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Of course, Sarah. I'm here for you. What's on your mind?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It's about Mark... he was hospitalized recently due to his mental health. I feel so helpless and worried."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm really sorry to hear that. It must be so hard to see someone you care about going through this. How are you holding up?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Honestly, I'm struggling. I want to help, but I'm scared of doing the wrong thing. It's like I'm walking on eggshells."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That sounds really challenging. It's natural to feel unsure, but your concern for Mark shows how much you care. Have you had a chance to talk to him or his doctors?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I haven't yet. I'm afraid of overwhelming him, or saying something that might upset him."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's understandable to feel that way, but even just letting him know you're there for him can be very comforting. Sometimes just being present is a big support."}]
</quoted_conversation_context>
You're right. I keep thinking about everything else that's been going on, too. Like the issues at work and my anxiety shooting up lately. It's all piling up.

[{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Hey, I've been going through a lot lately and could really use someone to talk to."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Hi Sarah, I'm here for you. What's been on your mind?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Well, I've made a big decision to cut down on my working hours."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's a significant step. How are you feeling about it?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It's a mix of relief and uncertainty. I'm glad to have more time for myself, but I worry about my career."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's completely normal to feel both relieved and anxious. Taking care of your mental health is crucial though."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"You're right. I've been trying to focus more on painting, as it helps with my stress."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's wonderful. Engaging in a hobby can be so therapeutic. Have you noticed any changes in how you feel since you started painting?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yes, definitely. It's like I can express what's inside without words, but sometimes the pressures of work still get to me."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It sounds like painting has become an important outlet for you. It's okay if work stress still creeps in; what matters is that you have ways to cope."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Thanks, I keep reminding myself of that. It's hard not to feel like I'm falling behind sometimes."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I understand. You've been through a lot with work and relationships. You're doing your best, and that's enough."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I try to remember that. The therapy sessions have helped too. I just worry about Mark being in the hospital; it brings back old anxieties."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's tough seeing someone you care about struggle. Have you managed to talk to Mark or visit him?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I did visit him. It was really hard, but I think he appreciated the company. I just wish I could do more."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Sometimes being there is enough. You're a good friend, and your support means a lot to him."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Thanks. I just hope he knows that he's not alone."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm sure he does. Keep taking care of yourself too; you need your strength to support others."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I will. Cutting back on work is a start, I suppose."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It absolutely is. It's a brave decision, and shows you're prioritizing your well-being."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Sometimes I just doubt if I'm doing the right thing."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Doubt can be part of the process, but remember that prioritizing yourself isn't wrong."}]
</quoted_conversation_context>
I guess so. It's just that balancing everything feels overwhelming at times.

But recently after I said I want to go on a trip with my boyfriend, my parents have all sorts of opinions about it. And all their traditional beliefs that I did not know existed are now on the surface and they are kinda forcing me to follow it. \\nseeker: For say they think \\\"bad types of woman\\\" go on trips with their boyfriends and I need to save myself. \\nseeker: They have been guilt tripping me and I feel very confused.\\nsupporter: Your feelings are valid and it is okay to feel confused in this situation considering you love your boyfriend and parents \\nsupporter: Have you tried discussing with your boyfriend to talk to your parents as a means of reassuring them?\\nsupporter: Or getting someone neutral that your parents trust to talk to them?\\nseeker: I have. It's been a long stressful month of discussion. The problem is I don't share their beliefs, and I haven't been really \\\"saving myself\\\". I'm been living away from them for collage quite a while and I've been basically doing stuff that if they found out they would be very upset about.\\nseeker: But I didn't think it bothers them because they never shared any of this. \\nseeker: And they said if I go on this trip I'm disrespecting them and the entire family. \\nseeker: But his parents are totally cool and don't seem to mind. \\nsupporter: I get how difficult and upsetting this situation is to you, i have been in a similar situation, however, in my case i took charge of my life, though they are my parents i did what i felt is good for me\\nsupporter: Before i continue, do you mind me asking how old you are?\\nseeker: I'm 26\\nseeker: And I see what you're saying.\\nseeker: It's really hard breaking free because they always monitored me my entire life. \\nseeker: I never had a voice for myself. They basically bullied and forced me to do what they wanted. \\nseeker: BTW if you didn't guess I'm their favorite child. \\nsupporter: Okay, you are old enough to be away from your parents, i am going to suggest you sitting with them down and having a heart to heart discussion with them\\nsupporter: Let them know the consequences of them forcing you, your feelings towards it and how unhappy you are with them restricting you\\nseeker: Should I tell them everything I did that goes against what they believe? \\nseeker: So they know that I don't share their beliefs? \\nsupporter: No, i think that should be personal to you, i would not suggest you hurting or making them see you as a disappointment\\nsupporter: I am sure you will be fine after discussing with them, they will come around\\nseeker: I guess worst case I won't talk to them for a while : ) \\nseeker: Thank you , that helped. \\nsupporter: They might be sad and upset now but they will get over it definitely\\nsupporter: You are welcome\\nseeker: Have a good one!\\nsupporter: You too\",\"kind\":\"MS\",\"reported_at\":\"2024-06-10\",\"schema\":\"pm-rl1-attributed-evidence-v2\",\"speaker_scope\":\"Historical seeker and supporter; neither role supplies an AI biography.\"}","head":"MS","rank":1,"source_time":"2024-06-10"}]
